Case reference: 2006002199.CaseDesc: On September 23, 1994, this Caucasian male, was found in a field on the south side of the Rogers Centre (formerly known as the SkyDome) at the far end of Rees Street in Toronto. His post-mortem length was approximately 6’2" and he weighed 162lbs, however, these measurements may not represent his actual living weight and height due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy.

Teeth: Missing several teeth; had a great deal of restorative work done in the past with multiple silver-amalgam restorations

Case reference: 2014004377.CaseDesc: On October 3, 2003, a family member contacted the police to report that Dwayne Ross had been missing since the evening of October 1. They indicated that Dwayne and his cousin had been drinking together that night, and that his cousin had lost sight of him in the bushes on their way home. Dwayne didn't return home. There were sightings following his disappearance, but no one spoke to Dwayne. These sightings are unconfirmed. Further unconfirmed sightings were reported across Canada and also investigated. Dwayne has not yet been found, and his whereabouts remain unknown.

Case reference: 1999108210.CaseDesc: René Bessette was abducted when he was 8 years old by his father, Roger Bessette, leaving behind his mother and siblings.  René's father's car was later found abandoned on the Victoria Bridge in Montreal, Quebec.  Photos of René have been age-progressed to 40 years old.

Case reference: 2024013367.CaseDesc: Vanda Suon was reported missing by his family after a long period of time with no contact. Vanda had moved from Manitoba to Edmonton, Alberta years earlier and was travelling between Edmonton and Whitecourt, Alberta during the summer of 2021. Vanda's last known activity was in Whitecourt, Alberta on September 18, 2021.

Case reference: 2006018599.CaseDesc: Richard Rees and Gregory Cook were last seen on July 17, 1998, leaving Sunnyside Beach, Nottawasaga Bay in Meaford, Ontario in a Schwill DS16 sailboat. The overturned sailboat was recovered, but Richard and Gregory have not been located.

Mark: Upper Back, pale birthmark on right side

Case reference: 2015019929.CaseDesc: On April 16, at approximately 9:00 a.m., Sribavan Kandasamy was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario.
